entries.en: Oh choom, it was craaaazy. Beautiful people. Preem drugs. Just a wide, open ocean of fucking.
entries.ro: Ooo, choom, a fost nebunie totală. Oameni frumoși. Drogurile, beton. Un ocean întreg de futut.

entries.en: I mean, at one point, I couldn't even say where my body stopped and the others began.
entries.ro: Adică, la un moment dat, nici nu mai știam unde mă termin eu și unde încep ceilalți.

entries.en: We were like... like... Choom, it was primal. Hundreds of sweaty, entwined bodies... The rhythm, the smell, the desire...
entries.ro: Eram ca... ca... Choom, a fost ceva animalic. Sute de corpuri transpirate, împletite... Ritmul, mirosul, dorința...

entries.en: It was like... Total ecstasy for hours and hours.
entries.ro: A fost ca... Extaz total ore în șir.

entries.en: Holy shit, choom. How do I get in on that? I mean, I'll pay anything.
entries.ro: Băi, frate! Choom, cum intru și eu în chestia asta? Adică, plătesc orice.

entries.en: Oh, it's not a matter of money.
entries.ro: Ei, nu e vorba de bani.

entries.en: Only Mordellini gets to choose who's in and who's out. He's got the final say on you, no way around it.
entries.ro: Doar Mordellini alege cine intră și cine iese. Are ultimul cuvânt despre tine, fără ocolișuri.
